_comment: Roll-call pages docs.legis renders against the biennium's FINAL seat roster, printing later special-election winners in place of the members who actually voted. Keyed by vote source URL; names map printed surname -> actual voter per the Assembly Journal of that day. An entry that matches no imported vote record fails the import. Never inferred.

https://docs.legis.wisconsin.gov/documen.basis: verified 2026-08-22: Assembly Journal Jan 3 2011 (pp. 5, 11-12) seats Huebsch (94th), Gottlieb (60th), Gunderson (83rd) and lists all three in the AR1 ayes; Doyle, Stroebel, Craig won those seats in the May 3 2011 specials and first appear on roll calls May 17 2011.
